reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Enrich Cream 50ml
reviews.text: Не увидела особого результата. Плохо впитывается
reviews.zh: 冇見到特別效果。吸收得差。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Enrich Cream 50ml
reviews.text: The SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Enrich Cream is soothing, lightweight, and leaves my skin feeling soft and nourished. It absorbs well without feeling heavy, and a little goes a long way, so the jar lasts quite a while. Great for keeping my skin comfortable and hydrated.
reviews.zh: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Enrich Cream有舒緩效果，質地輕盈，用完皮膚感覺柔軟滋潤。吸收得好又唔覺得heavy，仲要好少少就夠用，所以一罐可以用好耐。可以keep住皮膚舒適同保濕。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Enrich Cream 50ml
reviews.text: This is a good moisturizing cream, especially after using peeling or exfoliating products. It feels soothing on the skin, helps reduce irritation, and provides enough hydration without feeling heavy or greasy. It also absorbs well and doesn’t pill.
reviews.zh: 呢款係一款好嘅保濕霜，尤其喺用完peeling或去角質產品之後用。皮膚上有舒緩感，幫助減低刺激，提供足夠保濕又唔會覺得heavy或油笠。吸收力都好，唔會搓泥。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Enrich Cream 50ml
reviews.text: I’m buying this cream for the second time. The entire line from this brand is just wonderful! The cream moisturizes and nourishes without leaving a greasy film — my skin feels soft and hydrated. I also recommend trying the serum and toner from this series.
reviews.zh: 呢款面霜我第二次回購。成個brand嘅product line都好正！面霜保濕滋潤但唔會留低油笠薄膜，皮膚感覺柔軟保濕。亦推薦試吓呢個series嘅serum同toner。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Enrich Cream 50ml
reviews.text:
The cream is not sticky, it absorbs pretty fast in my skin. It is safe to use for sensitive skin like mine. There’s no scent and it makes my skin moisturize. I use this after the Probio Cica intensive ampoule.
You can feel your skin so soft after using it.
reviews.zh:
面霜唔黏笠，喺我皮膚上吸收得幾快。敏感肌如我都用得。冇香味，可以幫皮膚保濕。我會喺Probio Cica intensive ampoule之後用。
用完之後可以feel到皮膚超柔軟。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Enrich Cream 50ml
reviews.text: I really liked it. It is obvious that I used a lot, so I can definitely say that the cream nourishes well, and at the same time there is no film or shine on my oily skin. I use it together with niacinamide and there is not a single rash now.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意。明明我已經用咗好多，但可以肯定咁講面霜滋潤度好，同時喺我油性肌上面都唔會有薄膜或者光澤。我配搭niacinamide一齊用，而家一粒暗瘡都冇。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Enrich Cream 50ml
reviews.text: At first, my skin felt a bit irritated, and I thought maybe these cosmetics weren’t for me. However, after a couple of uses, as soon as my very sensitive skin got used to it, I realized this is probably the best cream I’ve ever used for nighttime application. It leaves my skin incredibly soft, helps with my problematic areas, and smoothens and nourishes my skin in a way no other product has. Highly recommend it!
reviews.zh: 一開始皮膚有少少刺激，我以為呢啲護膚品可能唔啱我用。但用咗幾次之後，當我超敏感嘅皮膚開始適應，我就發現呢款可能係我用過最適合夜晚用嘅面霜。用完之後皮膚軟到不得了，幫到我皮膚嘅問題位置，仲好似其他產品做唔到咁，平滑同滋潤我嘅皮膚。強烈推薦！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Enrich Cream 50ml
reviews.text: This is amazing in my sensitive combo skin with rosacea. It doesn’t break me out and feels so luxurious on my skin, adding that extra moisturizer. It’s creamy and spreads nicely in my skin. Love it so much especially during the cold season
reviews.zh: 我係有玫瑰痤瘡嘅敏感肌混合肌，用呢款勁amazing。唔會令我爆瘡，喺皮膚上feel好luxurious，可以額外保濕。質地creamy，喺皮膚上推開得好靚。尤其冬天真係超愛。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
